reason: Contract (problem.txt) requires exact single-rounding integer equality (atol=0/rtol=0) over the full public domain (every int32 accumulator legal, multipliers in [2^30,2^31), shifts 0..31) and explicitly forbids one-unit output errors. Kernel computes a*m in float64 (kernel.py lines 14-20), which cannot exactly represent products up to ~2^62. Probe t14 constructed 16 legal inputs (e.g. a=2147483646, m=1073741825, r=31, P=2^61-2) where the fp64 product rounds up to exactly 2^61, so floor(scaled+0.5) yields 1 while the exact rule and kernel.reference() both give 0 — 16/16 mismatched on the real GPU via kernel.run(). Earlier probes (t6: 8704 random positions, t9: 1,052,672 positions) passed only because the failure needs a product within one fp64 ulp of a halfway point, which random sampling cannot hit. This is a confirmed, in-scope violation of the mandated formula.
